breakdown.description: Sudden expansion causes irreversible mixing and head loss; Bernoulli (lossless) cannot be applied directly across the expansion without including the loss term.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error by stating 'Use Bernoulli's equation to calculate the pressure rise across the expansion' without including any head loss term. The ground truth requires accounting for the Borda–Carnot head loss h_L = (V1 - V2)²/(2g), but the generated text makes no mention of this loss term or the energy equation with losses.
